7725 Edmund Clarene Stedman 1833-1908 John Bartlett

 
 
 
NUMBER:
7725
 
AUTHOR:
Edmund Clarence Stedman
 (1833–1908)
 
QUOTATION:
Give me to die unwitting of the day,
And stricken in Life’s brave heat, with senses clear!
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Mors Benefica.
